sites.why: Rule 4: requests.post to https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions with 'Bearer {api_key}', where api_key is a per-call parameter fed from APIVLMPlanner.api_key <- sampling_loop_sync(api_key=state['planner_api_key']), a Gradio per-session gr.State value the user pastes into the 'Planner API Key' textbox (env OPENAI_API_KEY is only the initial default / fallback). Also rule 6: the only caller (api_vlm_planner.py:95) passes llm='gpt-4o-2024-11-20', which is neither a catalog id nor a listed dated equivalence. Without those it would be rule 7 handoff (raw HTTP to api.openai.com).
sites.adjudication: Raw requests.post to api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions (computer_use_demo/gui_agent/llm_utils/oai.py:70) whose key is a per-call parameter fed from the Gradio per-session state['planner_api_key'] that the user pastes into the 'Planner API Key' textbox (app.py:231,284-290,552-554; env OPENAI_API_KEY is only the initial default at app.py:59,70), so rule 4 applies before rule 7's handoff. Independently, rule 6 also flags it: the only live caller (gui_agent/planner/api_vlm_planner.py:35,95-99) pass

sites.why: Rule 2: run_ssh_llm_interleaved POSTs to http://{ssh_host}:{ssh_port}/v1/chat/completions, a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible Qwen2-VL server (e.g. computer_use_demo/remote_inference.py) whose host:port the user types into the API-key textbox at runtime. No auth header; self-hosted Qwen models.

Rule 2: Alibaba DashScope SDK (dashscope.MultiModalConversation.call), another vendor's endpoint. Model 'qwen-vl-max-latest' is not in the Router catalog (only qwen3p8-max), so rule 7 handoff does not apply. Reached via api_vlm_planner.py:109 when planner model is 'qwen2-vl-max'; key is per-session (gr.State) with QWEN_API_KEY fallback.
Manual test under `if __name__ == "__main__":` in qwen.py; not part of the shipped app path.

Rule 4: self.client = Anthropic(api_key=api_key) where api_key comes from sampling_loop_sync(api_key=state['planner_api_key']), a per-session Gradio gr.State value pasted into the UI textbox. Also rule 5: client.beta.messages.with_raw_response.create with betas=['computer-use-2024-10-22'] (computer-use beta tools). Also rule 6: model is the constant 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022' (loop.py:84 / PLANNER_MODEL_CHOICES_MAPPING), not a catalog id. The same expression can use AnthropicVertex()/AnthropicBedrock() when provider is vertex/bedrock, but app.py always sets actor_provider='anthropic' for this model, so the default Anthropic endpoint is the live path.

Rule 2: OpenAI(base_url=self.ui_tars_url, api_key=api_key) points at a self-hosted UI-TARS (vLLM) server whose URL is supplied at runtime (sampling_loop_sync ui_tars_url param; api_key defaults to ''). Model 'ui-tars' is a self-hosted model, not OpenAI.
Install/test helper script under install_tools/ (manual connectivity test for a UI-TARS server); not part of the shipped app.
